observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show a hand holding a PS4 game case, front cover visible, in front of a 'Prezin Gadgets' shop wall.
Cover reads 'PS4', 'THE WITCHER WILD HUNT', '18' PEGI rating, and 'CD PROJEKT RED' logo.
Only the front of the case is shown in both photos; no back cover, no open case, no disc visible.
Case appears to have a blue PS4-style spine/trim, consistent with a genuine PS4 retail case.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'PREZIN GADGETS' overlay both images.

claims.claim: Item is 'The Witcher Wild Hunt 111' (The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt)
claims.evidence: photo 0 and photo 1 show the printed cover title and PS4 branding

risks.risk: Disc may be missing, scratched, or non-functional
risks.proof: A photo of the open case showing the disc, and ideally a clip of it loading on a PS4
risks.if_unproven: priced as if disc missing/not working

risks.risk: Case could be cracked or hinge broken, not visible from front-only shots
risks.proof: A photo of the case opened fully and from the side/back
risks.if_unproven: priced as case condition unknown, assume cosmetic wear

risks.risk: Manual/inlay or original packaging inserts could be missing
risks.proof: A photo of the inside cover and any inserts

risks.risk: Possible counterfeit or resurfaced disc sold as original
risks.proof: A clear photo of the disc surface and printed PS4 hologram/logo on the disc itself
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified authenticity, worst case treated as generic/unofficial copy

proof_requests: Photo of the case fully open showing the disc resting in the tray
Photo of the disc's printed side (label, hologram, scratches)
Photo of the back cover and spine for completeness check
A short video of the disc loading on a PS4 console to confirm it reads
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a PS4 copy of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt from the cover art, but disc presence and working condition are unverifiable from the photos, so it must be priced at the worst case (as if the disc is missing or non-functional) until further proof is given.
